note: Maintained by policy-radar. Only changes from sources scored 4 or higher (or two sources scored 3) are logged as material. Entries below are real events; the 'so_what' lines are written for the fictional sample org.

entries.headline: CMS lets states delay work-requirement disenrollments to June 30, 2027 (hold-harmless option)
entries.so_what: If Illinois, Indiana and Oregon elect it, coverage losses hit cash in Q3 instead of Q1. Watch for state announcements.

entries.headline: Oregon, Minnesota, New Mexico and Washington sue over the work requirements
entries.so_what: Oregon sites could see a different timeline. No change to plan dates until a court acts.

entries.headline: Final 2027 physician fee schedule: conversion factor down 2.31% for most clinicians
entries.so_what: Deeper than the July proposal. Downside model rerun; Medicare Advantage contracts paid off the fee schedule inherit it.
